name: lightbridge-governance
description: Serves governed language models to VS Code chat through the Lightbridge AI gateway.

lightbridge.gatewayUrl.markdownDescription: Base URL of the AI gateway, e.g. `https://api.ai.camer.digital`. Unset, the extension contributes no models at all — it never falls back to a default endpoint. Mirrors `gateway_url` in `governance-auth`'s config; leave unset to inherit that value instead of restating it here.

lightbridge.governanceAuthPath.markdownDescription: Path to the `governance-auth` binary. The extension shells out to `governance-auth token` for every request rather than holding a credential of its own (ADR-0010, ADR-0012). An absolute path is safer: this is spawned without a shell, so `PATH` resolution depends on the environment VS Code was launched from.

lightbridge.requestTimeoutMs.description: Abort a chat request that has produced no further output within this many milliseconds.

lightbridge.catalogueTtlMs.description: How long the model catalogue fetched from the gateway is reused before being re-fetched.

lightbridge.modelOptionDefaults.markdownDescription: Sampling parameters merged into every request — `temperature`, `top_p`, `top_k`, `seed`. Only parameters the model declares in the gateway catalogue's `supported_parameters` are forwarded; anything else is dropped. Copilot Chat *does* populate `modelOptions`, but with its own internal fields (`_otelTraceContext`, `_telemetryTurn` and similar) rather than sampling values, which is why the allowlist exists. A caller's `modelOptions` wins over these defaults.

scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.package: npm run typecheck && npm run build && vsce package --out lightbridge-governance.vsix
